environmentVariables.description: Card plan API key — easiest way to get started. Get one free at https://skim402.com/pricing. Unlocks higher rate limits without a crypto wallet.
environmentVariables.name: SKIM_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Wallet pay alternative: Base-network private key (0x-prefixed). Fund with a small USDC balance on Base to pay $0.002 per read call via x402. Use SKIM_API_KEY instead if you prefer a card plan.
environmentVariables.name: SKIM_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional cap on per-call price in USD (default 0.01). Requests priced above this are rejected before payment.
environmentVariables.name: SKIM_MAX_PRICE_USD

headers.description: Optional wallet pay path: Base wallet private key (0x-prefixed) — unlocks paid tools at $0.002/$0.005/$0.015 per call via x402. For the easier card plan (API key, no wallet), visit https://skim402.com/pricing instead.
headers.name: X-Skim-Wallet-Key

server.name: io.github.JessieJanie/skim402
server.description: Clean markdown and structured web data. Free card API key; wallet/x402 pay-per-call optional.

environmentVariables.description: Recommended. Card-plan API key (sk402_...). Get a free key at https://skim402.com/pricing. Takes priority over SKIM_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY. Enables read_url, read_urls, extract_url, crawl_url, read_pdf, watch, and poll_signal without a wallet.
environmentVariables.name: SKIM_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Base-network wallet private key (0x-prefixed, 64 hex chars) for x402 pay-per-call if you are not using SKIM_API_KEY. Fund with a small amount of USDC on Base. Ignored when SKIM_API_KEY is set.
environmentVariables.name: SKIM_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional cap on per-call price in USD (default 0.01). Wallet lane only. Raise (e.g. 0.05) for batch/extract/watch. Requests that would cost more than this are rejected without payment.
environmentVariables.name: SKIM_MAX_PRICE_USD

headers.description: Optional. Without it, skim_read works on the shared free tier. To pay per call via x402 wallet: add a Base wallet private key (fresh, low-balance agent wallet) — unlocks paid tools at $0.002/$0.005/$0.015. Card plan alternative (API key): https://skim402.com/pricing
headers.name: X-Skim-Wallet-Key
